title: Entity Matching & Data Integration
description: We develop scalable techniques for automatically identifying records that refer to the same real-world entity across heterogeneous data sources. Our approaches leverage pre-trained language models (BERT, LLMs), graph neural networks, and active learning to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy with minimal human supervision.

title: NLP & Text Analytics
description: Our NLP research spans information extraction, fact verification, document classification, and large language model applications. We work on structured and unstructured data from domains including finance (ESG reporting), healthcare, and scientific literature.

title: Time Series Analysis
description: We investigate representation learning, clustering, and anomaly detection for multivariate time series data, with applications in industrial monitoring, predictive maintenance, and energy systems. Our flagship project time2feat learns interpretable feature representations for time series clustering.

title: ML in Database Systems
description: We explore the integration of machine learning inference directly within database management systems, enabling efficient in-database analytics without data movement overhead. This line of research bridges the gap between database query processing and modern ML frameworks.

title: Anomaly & Novelty Detection
description: We design and evaluate unsupervised and semi-supervised algorithms for detecting anomalies and novel patterns in complex data streams. Our autoencoder-based methods are deployed in real industrial environments for health monitoring and predictive maintenance.

title: Knowledge Graphs & Semantic Web
description: We build and exploit knowledge graphs for data integration, semantic search, and question answering. Our research addresses ontology alignment, knowledge base population, and keyword-based search over structured datasets using semantic reasoning.
